items.title: Transcription ke marhale aur mRNA ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the phases of transcription and mRNA processing (PDF 133-136).

blocks.text: Is marhale mein primer ki zaroorat nahin hoti. Enzyme RNA polymerase template DNA par nucleotides ke aik khaas sequence se jurta hai jise promoter kehte hain. Promoter khud transcribe nahin hota. Maslan:

items: Prokaryotes mein promoter TTGACA gene ke start point se 35 nucleotides pehle hota hai, is liye ise –35 sequence bhi kehte hain.
Prokaryotes mein doosra promoter TATAAT start point se 10 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –10 sequence kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Double-stranded DNA par prokaryotic promoter. Coding strand 5' se 3': -35 sequence par TTGACA, -10 sequence par TATAAT aur start point par A; template strand 3' se 5' par in ke complementary AACTGT, ATATTA aur T. Hara teer 5' se 3' transcription ki simt dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.13: Prokaryotes mein promoters (kitab ki Figure 19.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Coding strand, Template strand, -35 sequence, -10 sequence, Start point, Transcription, 5', 3'.

items: Eukaryotes mein promoter TATAAA (TATA box) start point se 25 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –25 sequence kehte hain.
Eukaryotes mein promoter GGCCAATCT (CAAT box) start point se 70 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –70 sequence kehte hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Prokaryotes mein sirf aik RNA polymerase hota hai jo teenon qisam ke RNA banata hai. Eukaryotes mein teen alag RNA polymerases hain: RNA polymerase I nucleolus mein rRNA banata hai, RNA polymerase II mRNA banata hai, aur RNA polymerase III tRNA banata hai.
RNA polymerase paanch subunits (hisson) ka bana hota hai:

items: do α subunits regulatory proteins se jurte hain,
aik β′ subunit template DNA se jurta hai,
aik β subunit RNA nucleotides se jurta hai, aur
aik σ subunit promoter ko pehchaan kar RNA banna shuru karta hai.

blocks.text: Jab RNA polymerase promoter se jurta hai to us ka σ subunit alag ho jata hai. Baqi chaar subunits (core enzyme) kaam aage barhate hain: DNA helix kholte hain aur nucleotide pairs (base pairs) torte hain. Is se bulbule jaisa structure banta hai jise transcription bubble kehte hain. RNA ki zanjeer isi bubble mein banti hai.
